title: Phytochemical composition comprising Boswellia serrata and Commiphora mukul for synovial protection
text: A synergistic oral botanical composition combining 3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA) and guggulsterones, providing dual inhibition of 5-lipoxygenase and NF-kappa-B for cartilage integrity in osteoarthritis.
